Georgia Residential Contractor Services

Build Heritage is a Georgia home‑services contractor serving metro Atlanta and the rest of Georgia. Get a free, written, itemized quote within one business day and start planning your project.

How it works for a whole‑home interior repaint in Atlanta

  1. Visit the Itemized Contractor Quote page and fill out the quote form.
  2. Submit your contact info; you’ll receive a written estimate by the next business day.
  3. Review the estimate (typical range $3,000‑$8,000) and decide if you want to proceed.
  4. Schedule the painting crew; they arrive, prep, and paint according to the plan.
  5. After completion, you pay the quoted amount and keep the itemized receipt for records.

What you get and the cost guide

  • Access to 8 trades: Packing & Moving, Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles.
  • Free, written, itemized quote delivered within one business day.
  • Cost ranges from our August 2026 guide: full roof replacement $9,000‑$20,000; whole‑home interior repaint $3,000‑$8,000.
  • The guide recommends holding back 10‑15% of the quoted amount for hidden issues.

FAQ

How quickly will I get a quote? You will receive a written, itemized quote within one business day after submitting the form.

Are you licensed and insured? Yes, Build Heritage is licensed and insured in Georgia.

Which areas do you serve? We work in Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, Columbus, and surrounding metro areas.

What trades can you handle for my home? We provide services in Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Doors, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles, and Packing & Moving.

Start with a free quote now → Itemized Contractor Quote
